Challenges

What’s preventing your small business from thriving online?

“Why is my website not getting enough organic traffic?”

Usually thin service pages and no local signals. We audit what exists, then build the pages and profile strength your market rewards.

“Why do I rank for keywords that bring no leads or sales?”

Rankings without intent are decoration. We re-map keywords to the services and areas that produce enquiries.

“Why don’t we show up in local searches or Google Maps?”

Map visibility runs on your Business Profile, citations and reviews. We fix all three in the order Google weighs them.

“Why do bigger competitors outrank us online?”

They win on content depth and authority, not size of budget. We target the searches where a focused local business beats a generic national one.

“Why do visitors leave without enquiring?”

Slow pages, unclear offers and missing trust signals. We fix the path from landing to enquiry and measure the change.

“Why is my site slow and hard to use on mobile?”

Most small-business searches happen on phones. We streamline templates and media so the mobile experience stops costing you customers.

“Why isn’t my content answering what customers search for?”

Because it was written for the business, not the buyer. We rebuild it around real questions from your market.

“Why don’t we appear in AI Overviews or AI answers?”

AI tools recommend businesses with consistent data and strong reviews. The same foundations we build for local SEO earn those mentions.

Our Process

Our small business SEO process

1

Small business SEO audit

Your site, profile, reviews and local presence graded against the competitors customers actually compare you with.

2

Competitor & local market gap analysis

Where nearby rivals win, where they are weak, and which searches are realistically yours first.

3

Search intent & keyword mapping

The phrases your customers use, mapped to the service pages that should win them.

4

On-page & service page optimisation

Titles, content and structure rebuilt around buying intent.

5

Local SEO & Business Profile optimisation

Profile, citations and reviews working together for map-pack visibility.

6

Website performance & technical fixes

Speed, mobile and crawl fixes that stop the site leaking visitors.

7

Trust building, citations & link growth

Local links and mentions that prove you are the established choice in your area.

8

AI search, reporting & conversion growth

AI mentions monitored, results reported monthly, and pages tuned to convert the traffic you earn.

SEO Growth

Why small business SEO matters for long-term growth

Small businesses do not need everything. They need the right things: a website Google can understand, a Business Profile that wins the map, reviews that build trust, and pages for the services that make money.

Our small business programs strip SEO to those essentials, price them predictably, and report in plain language — you always know what was done and what it produced.

Reach customers without relying only on ads

Ads stop the day the budget does. A well-built organic presence keeps your phone ringing between campaigns — and makes every paid click cheaper by raising the trust customers find when they check you out.

Build local trust before customers contact you

Reviews, accurate listings and helpful service pages do the persuading in advance. By the time a customer calls, they have already decided you are the credible local choice.

Stay visible in AI and zero-click search

More searches now end with an AI answer instead of a click. Businesses with consistent data, strong reviews and clear service pages are the ones those answers name — the same foundations this program builds.

FAQs

FAQs on small business SEO services

How much does small business SEO cost?

Programs start at starter-plan level with fixed monthly pricing — compare plans on our pricing page, and your free proposal confirms the exact fit.

How soon will the phone ring?

Profile wins can show in weeks; sustainable growth builds over 3–6 months. We report enquiries, not just rankings, so you see it happen.

Do I need a new website?

Usually not. We fix what you have first; a rebuild is suggested only when the current site blocks results.

Am I locked into a contract?

Programs are monthly with clear terms — we keep clients by performing, not by paperwork.
